migrationNotes: Movement + Normal1-5 + E Skill + Q Ultimate + forward/back dodge + shared dodge attack. Normal6/QTE remain outside the scope. Legacy Rush clip has no ATK/gate events: initial authored hit frames 6/12 (20 damage each), preinput15/ready18/move18; tune in Skill Editor. No legacy dodge invincibility window exists; none added. Ultimate follows runtime Ultimate defense policy. Front dodge keeps original 750ms bake; back dodge baked to original Animator exit time. Skill/ultimate recovery can be cancelled from the final segment.
